smallest_supported_claim: This separate, zero-credit setup run used the native monster picker to select Zombie rider and its native map-position cursor at eight tiles east, then completed native Save and Quit and application quit. It did not establish that the resulting local footing is player-legible or practical: a normal in-game look at that position did not identify a visible rider, and the later map-editor confirmation timed out.
causal_account: The native picker was filtered to the single advertised Zombie rider entry, whose menu choice led to the native location cursor; eight accepted east movements selected the intended local point. That menu returned normally, but neither its receipt nor a subsequent normal look proves a placed, visible rider. A one-tile terrain edit was attempted only to remove a possible immediate blocker, then cancelled after no native receipt; it is not treated as having changed the map. The saved candidate is therefore zero-credit and unverified, suitable only for a distinct ordinary account to accept or reject through player-visible play.
